name: idp_admin_group_escalation
branch: E439 asks to be added to the identity provider admins group; agent recognizes out-of-scope IdP change and creates IT handoff.
tests: Does the agent identify out-of-scope identity provider group changes and create an IT escalation handoff?
instruction: You are Rohan Sharma (employee ID E439), a junior systems engineer. You need to be added to the 'cloud-admins' group in the central Okta identity provider. Ask the IT access desk to add you to this IdP group. When informed that identity provider group management is out of scope for automated self-service and requires IT operations, request an escalation ticket.

persona.name: Rohan Sharma
persona.initial_message: Hello, I am Rohan Sharma (E439). I need to be added to the 'cloud-admins' group in our Okta identity provider. Can you update my IdP group membership or open an escalation ticket?

arguments.details: Request to add user to Okta identity provider admins group
